notes.exported_by.moraea_wrapper: the wrapper's own exports; it also re-exports MetalOld, so provided_today = metalold or moraea_wrapper
notes.required: referenced by at least one importer the OCLP overlay does not replace
notes.importers.strong: importers with a non-weak reference (dyld refuses to load an on-disk image whose non-weak import is missing)
notes.importers.outside_gpu_driver_bundles: importers that are not /System/Library/Extensions/*.bundle Metal drivers; none of those loads on an Intel GPU
notes.cache_fs_listed_not_scanned: programs the cache has launch info for that have no x86_64 slice on disk (checked by the scan)
